scaling: StandardScaler mean and population standard deviation, fitted separately on each origin's matured training rows only; constant columns use scale 1. No target scaling.
training: Expanding window. For each 2023 forecast, use 2019-2022 rows plus earlier 2023 rows whose full target has matured strictly before the forecast cutoff. Refit scaling and ridge at each origin for each fixed alpha. Never fit the current or future target.

models.M0: Persistence: predict the latest observed weekly OVX mean, with no fitted parameters.
models.M1: Intercept plus ridge regression on latest weekly OVX and its trailing four-week mean; unconstrained predictions, no clipping or postprocessing.

selection: Select M1 alpha by smallest pooled 2023 validation MAE, ties by larger alpha. M0 remains a benchmark regardless of results. Do not expand the grid or change predictors from validation diagnostics. No automatic model replacement or financial claim from these selection scores.
metrics: MAE primary, RMSE secondary, in OVX points, on identical 52 target weeks. Report M1 minus M0 errors (negative favours M1), quarter diagnostics and largest absolute errors. No independence-based confidence intervals for 52 dependent validation weeks.
final_snapshot: After validation selection, save a safe JSON M1 scaler and regression fitted to all matured 2019-2023 rows at 2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00, for later chronological evaluation. This is not a fixed model for all future weeks; later expanding fits must retain the selected alpha.
test_policy: Do not parse primary_test.jsonl, financial_rows.jsonl, weekly_ovx.jsonl or raw OVX values in this experiment. Integrity checks may hash existing files. No final-test predictions, metrics or tuning until news specifications and the final evaluation protocol are frozen.
limitations: Validation is used to select regularisation; selected scores are not untouched test estimates.
Observed OVX weekly means and target maturity use the frozen retrospective dataset; exchange-session completeness and actual release times remain unverified.
Adjacent weeks and crisis periods are dependent; comparative accuracy does not establish significance, causality or tradability.
This step evaluates market-only baselines; incremental news usefulness is still untested.
